overloads.semanticRole: The SET DRAG ICON command associates the icon picture with the cursor during drag and drop operations that are managed by programming.

constraints: Must be called in the context of the On Begin Drag Over form event.
icon's maximum size is 256x256 pixels; larger pictures are automatically resized.
If horOffset/vertOffset are omitted, the cursor is placed at the center of the icon.
horOffset: positive = offset towards the left, negative = offset towards the right.
vertOffset: positive = offset upwards, negative = offset downwards.
